definitions: David D. Cohen is an American lawyer and former government official who served as the Deputy Director of the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) from 2015 to 2017.
David D. Cohen is an American attorney who served as the Under Secretary of the Treasury for Terrorism and Financial Intelligence from 2011 to 2015.
examples: David D. Cohen was instrumental in developing new strategies for combating terrorist financing.
The former Deputy Director of the CIA, David D. Cohen, gave a lecture on national security.
